notes.title: Meet the big important update 1.5.3!
notes.content:
The main topic of this update is [b]performance improvements[/b]. We received a lot of complaints about low game performance and occasional freezes in game sessions with a lot of unlocked cities and running routes. It took us a lot of time to improve pathfinding and passenger generation algorithms, but we managed it. Now the game should be able to handle a large number of routes much easier. If you experienced performance problems before, please let us know how much better the game is on the new version.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40269024/b58683d64eb337f33c86723f1e690f3b3f847797.jpg[/img]
Also, important changes have been made to some scenarios. There were some that were too easy or too difficult. Changes have been made to scenarios: Caribbean Islands, Volatile Passenger Flow, Passenger Spike, Domestic Flights.

[b]List of other changes:[/b]
- Fixed a bug where you could get the “Millionaire” achievement by loading two saves, one after another
- Now if you load a game that was saved during the city overcrowd timer countdown, the timer value is retained
- Speed of camera movement with buttons no longer depends on whether VSync is on or off
- Removed erroneous refreshing of the scenario list while adding a scenario to favorites
- Fixed a bug where passenger generation would increase if the same save was loaded several times in a row
- Fixed a bug where in the Caribbean scenario, the statistics screen showed more territories than were actually unlocked.
- Fixed a bug where a city could overflow with just one passenger in Ladder mode
- Fixed a bug with “Discover the World” mode freezing when unlocking the final territory
- Fixed a bug with the presence of passenger generation in cities that were blocked by an event

We continue to actively work on the game and prepare something new and interesting for you in the near future. Thank you for playing Fly Corp!

notes.title: Accurate and optimized route search - meet the 1.5.1 update!
notes.content:
Previously, for optimization, we used a pathfinding algorithm with an approximate calculation of the optimal route. This means that in complex situations, the algorithm gave close to optimal, but not the most optimal routes. We have long been trying to improve the path search algorithm to increase its accuracy and performance. This is a truly non-trivial task. And now, finally, we have succeeded.

[b]Now passengers should choose the most optimal route[/b] from the departure city to the final destination city for transfers. At the same time, you should be able to see [b]improved performance[/b] of the game.

Also in this version:
- Fixed a bug when in some rare cases the statistics screen showed more territories than were actually unlocked
- Fixed a bug where passengers could try travelling to a city that was not yet connected
- Fixed a problem with city names in the tutorial when switching languages from the pause menu

notes.content:
We continue to work not only on new updates for Fly Corp, but also on a new game in the same vein. It's called Check Inn:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2741390/Check_Inn/

The update is really important, so those who have already completed the demo are invited to play again. The gameplay really feels different now.

The most important thing is that we have added [i][b]service rooms[/b][/i]. That is, any guest who stays at the hotel for more than 3 nights may want:
[list]
[*] Food delivery from [i][b]the kitchen[/b][/i] to their room. Accordingly, the hotel must have at least one [i][b]kitchen[/b][/i].
[*] Washing their dirty clothes. In this case, the guest leaves a basket with dirty clothes in the hallway, and [i][b]the porter[/b][/i] must take it to [i][b]the laundry[/b][/i]. There, the clothes are loaded into the washing machine (or machines). When the washing is finished, [i][b]the porter[/b][/i] takes the clean clothes back to the room.
[*] Take a steam bath in [b][i]the sauna[/i][/b]. The guest themselves goes by elevator to the floor where the sauna is located and occupies one of the rooms in it for a while. One room - one guest.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44888383/bb3c1542d71fc5f5d9827cf1ae33f2f1fe56485c.jpg[/img]
As you can see, a new important role has been added to the hotel - [i][b]the porter[/b][/i]. They can carry two items on their carts: food, dirty or clean laundry. If you see that one [i][b]porter[/b][/i] can no longer cope with the delivery, you can hire a few more.

Each of the [i][b]service rooms[/b][/i] can be upgraded. For example, in [i][b]the kitchen[/b][/i], you can increase the speed of cooking, their quality, capacity (affects the number of ready meals that [i][b]the porter[/b][/i] can pick up at any time).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44888383/c8d2fc12d54a6859afad9caa3c352c75204360a3.jpg[/img]
We also added the ability to [i][b]zoom the camera[/b][/i] in and out. This can be done using the mouse wheel. And you can now move the camera to the side using the arrows on the keyboard or the WASD keys.
Due to the mentioned changes, the entire demo version level has undergone a serious rebalance. Please let us know about your opinion on this update. Did you like the fact that the gameplay in the game is becoming more profound? As always, we read all messages and try to respond to them.

notes.title: Our plans for this Fall
notes.content:
Today we will share our plans: what we are going to work on in the coming months. As always, we would like to hear your opinion on these ideas.

[h3]New monthly game modes[/h3]

Currently, the game has daily scenarios, but of course there is not an infinite number of them and after some time they inevitably repeat. We would like to add variety by adding monthly modes to the game (that is, those that are available for one month and then change to another one). For example:
- A game mode in which passengers from everywhere want to fly to one specific city. This city is selected every N minutes, so you will constantly have to monitor the altering direction of the passenger flow.
- A game mode in which new cities can be unlocked by the player themselves. There are two options (we have not yet come up with which one is more interesting, but we may implement both): a random city opens when the player presses a button; the player themselves selects from a bunch of cities on the map (marked in muted gray) the one they want to include in the game, and only after that passengers will start gathering there.
- Speedrun. A variation of "Discover the World", but the main task will be to complete it in time. Accordingly, the main parameter in the leaderboard will be completion time, not the number of points scored.

These are just some of our ideas regarding monthly game modes. If players especially like one of them, we will make it available on a permanent basis or repeat it as part of the monthly schedule.

We also plan to work on optimizing the game and improving pathfinding algorithms. In fact, both tasks are intertwined and require an integrated approach. Such improvements can take many months of hard work, so we are not ready to name exact ETAs yet.

[h3]DLC with the United States of America[/h3]

We expect to make a DLC dedicated to the USA as a separate product. Firstly, this is logical, since it will be necessary to create a separate map, scenarios, balance and change the logic of some game processes. Secondly, this way we will get financial opportunities to further support the game (see the above-described new modes and work on optimization/improvement of algorithms).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40269024/710a6bcd0a057afb5d2c9351aac6085f1e5cde40.png[/img]
[h3]What to expect from the expansion?[/h3]

We would like to implement the ability to unlock each existing state, and make a unique visual representation of each of them. Probably, we will also have to rework the parameters of the aircraft capacity (and maybe even add helicopters?), change the balance of the game in general. As in the original game, we would like to have both the "Unlock all States" mode and Scenarios in which various unusual situations would be played out.

[b]It is important for us to know your opinion. What do you think about the above plans?[/b] Please write your comments: we read all of them, and, if necessary, try to respond. You can also discuss the news on our Discord server: http://discord.gg/invite/9eHyYap

notes.title: Major update 1.4 - new balance of "Discover the World" and new localizations!
notes.content:
[h2]Major changes:[/h2]

- New balance of the "Discover the World" mode. We tried to make it more enjoyable and interesting. By "more enjoyable" we mean a changed income curve, prices for opening new countries and building routes. In the previous version of the game, the number on the balance is often more than tens and hundreds of millions. In the new one, you will have to operate with smaller numbers, and this is much more convenient.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40269024/9294a7f050a4805c9d04aff958c90fff82a1a94d.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40269024/ee1844a6af7de3dba497481da753bd70ca8aabc7.png[/img]
Along with the rebalance, we completely reset the leaderboards and deleted all saves made in the previous version of this game mode (this is a forced step, since the changes in the balance are too big to be able to load old saves). As a tribute to our loyal players, we leave access to the old leaderboards in the game. So you don't have to worry about your high score going into oblivion.

- The option to start the "Discover the World" mode from a random country. Attention! This option is only suitable for experienced players, as the difficulty from the very beginning of the game can be significantly higher due to large territories. For those who are not ready to restart due to randomness, we recommend playing the classic version starting from Germany.
- The option to turn off the automatic panning of the camera to a crowded city. Now it is replaced by arrows with a timer; they show in which direction the crowded city is. The option is in the game settings.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40269024/8f4ac636139d862c8560ef9a0043069f6be6f1f1.png[/img]
- The option to turn off messages that the city is almost full. This option will appeal to those who find such messages annoying.
- Two new languages ​​​​have been added - Vietnamese and Arabic. And this time, the introduction of a new language turned out to be a very difficult task. After all, in Arabic, the text is written from right to left! Buttons, signatures, numbers - all this shifted, mixed up, and confusion reigned on the screen. We had to change the logic of the interface, edit many elements, manually separate the numbers (after all, unlike the text, they are written from left to right). In general, the amount of work turned out to be much more than we expected. But we hope that our efforts were not in vain, and this will allow native speakers of these two languages ​​to play our game with ease.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40269024/de75a96f6daa6180f00894b792d25d3172c390e0.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40269024/271cda3e6c143337213b4087bd2591e5ae8708ad.png[/img]
- New balance of the "Loan payment", "Continents" and "Long distances" scenarios.
The first scenario, in which the balance periodically goes into the negative, was too easy. Now it can be determined as a medium-difficulty scenario. "Long distances" and "Continents" on the contrary were made easier, since in the previous version after rewriting the algorithm for calculating the cost of tickets they were unbeatable. However, these two scenarios still remain quite difficult, as they were originally intended.

[h2]Other changes:[/h2]

- Fixed a bug that caused passengers to be generated at a very high rate in some cities after loading a save.
- Fixed button overlaps and UI issues at different resolutions.
- Fixed a bug where players' score points that were too high could overlap the edge of the user scenario card.
- Fixed a bug that prevented the "Active Pause" achievement from being unlocked.
- Fixed the display of events on the editor timeline. Previously, if there were too many events, they would stop being displayed.
- You can no longer earn achievements in the tutorial.
- If you upgrade an overcrowded city while paused, the camera will no longer move to it after you unpause the game.
- Removed a small visual bug in the free play progress bar in the dark theme.
- Removed a bug that caused the pause button to turn black if you changed the game language while paused.
- Other minor fixes.

We continue to work on supporting and improving the game. We will share our plans for future updates soon.
In the meantime, we are waiting for your feedback on the current update. Write what you like and what you don't like. Thank you for playing Fly Corp!

As always, we invite you to our Discord server to discuss this major update - http://discord.gg/invite/9eHyYap and to subscribe to our page on Steam - https://store.steampowered.com/developer/kishmish.

notes.title: We invite you to the open beta test of a new major update!
notes.content:
Before releasing the next update, we would like to first know the opinion of players who want to participate in testing. Without exaggeration, this is one of the most important updates this year. There are quite a few changes, but in this post we will dwell in more detail on what we would like to hear your opinion about in the first place.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40269024/0806382f5984be6c5ddbd7abc1c5b614bd3c42bd.png[/img]
[h2]New balance of "Discover the World" and "Free play"[/h2]

We completely rebalanced both modes. We did not like the way the cost of tickets was calculated before as it was somewhat chaotic. Now, this value changes smoothly.

Next, a little about how the calculations happen "under the hood". The more territories are unlocked, the more the costs of supporting the infrastructure are. This is reflected in the ticket price. For example, for delivering a passenger from point A to point B, when 1 territory is unlocked, you get a little more than when 10 territories are unlocked. However, in general, due to the constantly increasing passenger flow, you still earn more and more money in total. If we did not change the ticket price, the amount earned would quickly exceed all conceivable limits - hundreds of trillions.

The cost of unlocking new territories and the cost of creating routes at later stages of the game were reduced. Now the numbers are more convenient to operate.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40269024/ee1844a6af7de3dba497481da753bd70ca8aabc7.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40269024/9294a7f050a4805c9d04aff958c90fff82a1a94d.png[/img]
It also became possible to start the run of "Discover the World" from a random territory. This option is more suitable for experienced players, since it is almost always more difficult to play than in a compact European region. But at the start, you are given twice as much money.

Try the new balance and share your opinion. We worked on it for a really long time, and it is important for us to know that our efforts were not in vain.

[h2]New balance of the "Loan payment" and "Long distances" scenarios[/h2]

The first scenario, in which the balance periodically goes into the negative, was too easy. Now it can be classified as a medium-difficulty scenario.

"Long distances" on the contrary was made easier, since in the previous version after rewriting the algorithm for calculating the cost of tickets it was impossible. However, the scenario still remains difficult, as it was originally intended.

Important! We need your opinion about these and other official scenarios in the game. Maybe some of them seem too easy to you, and others are impossible? Write, we will definitely check and make adjustments if necessary.

[h2]New options - arrows indicating overcrowded cities and disabling notifications[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40269024/8f4ac636139d862c8560ef9a0043069f6be6f1f1.png[/img]
By popular demand, we have added two extremely useful options:
- The option to disable the automatic panning of the camera to an overcrowded city. Instead, an arrow with a timer is displayed at the edge of the screen.
- The option to turn off messages about the city being almost full. This option will appeal to those who find such messages annoying.

[h2]New languages - Arabic and Vietnamese[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40269024/271cda3e6c143337213b4087bd2591e5ae8708ad.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40269024/de75a96f6daa6180f00894b792d25d3172c390e0.png[/img]
If you know one of these languages, we would be grateful if you let us know about any mistakes you notice. However, we tried to make high-quality professional translations and refactored the interface so that the new languages are displayed correctly in the game.

[h2]Many minor edits[/h2]
In addition, we fixed the bugs found before and made minor changes to the game. The full list will be published when the update is released for public access to everyone.

[h2]How to join the Beta?[/h2]

[b]We are starting testing in a closed branch of Steam.[/b] To switch to the test branch on Steam, find the game in your library, right-click on it and select "Properties" in the context menu. There, go to the "Betas" tab and enter the code flycorppublictest. After that, you will be able to switch to the closed test branch public_test in the list above.

Attention! Do not forget to switch back to the default branch after you finish inspecting the test branch, otherwise you will not receive fresh game updates in the future, which are published in the default branch.

[h3]Attention!!![/h3] If you have any saves of the game in the "Discover the World" mode, it is better to copy them manually into a separate folder. When starting the new version, they will be automatically deleted, since the entire balance is new and is not compatible with the old save files.

As always, we invite you to our Discord server to discuss the Beta - http://discord.gg/invite/9eHyYap and to subscribe to our page on Steam - https://store.steampowered.com/developer/kishmish.

notes.title: A major update is coming soon!
notes.content:
You may have noticed that we have taken a short break from releasing updates. The thing is that we have spent a lot of time on the new balance for the "Discover the World" and "Free Play" modes. We tried to make it more enjoyable and interesting. By "more enjoyable" we mean an adjusted income curve, prices for unlocking new countries and building routes. In the current version of the game, the account balance is often tens and a hundreds of millions. In the new one, you will have to operate with smaller numbers, and this is much more convenient. Soon you will be able to see this for yourself, since we will soon launch an open beta test on a separate Steam branch.

Along with the rebalance, we will completely reset the leaderboard. However, as a tribute to our loyal players, we leave access to the old leaderboard in the game. So, there is no need to worry about your high score going into oblivion. Instead, roll up your sleeves and get ready for new heights!

We decided to listen to the players and implement two wishes that have been popular in the community for a long time. The first is the ability to turn off the automatic camera panning to the overcrowded city (now it is replaced by arrows with a timer; they show in which direction the overcrowded city is - see the attached screenshot). The second is the ability to start the "Discover the World" run from a random territory. It is very likely that it will not be easy to play with this setting enabled, since starting from large territories is noticeably more difficult than from classic Europe. So, this setting is rather intended for players who already have some experience in the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40269024/8f4ac636139d862c8560ef9a0043069f6be6f1f1.png[/img]
We also decided to add two new languages to the game, Vietnamese and Arabic.

And this time, the implementation of a new language turned out to be a very difficult task. After all, in Arabic, the text is written from right to left! Buttons, captions, numbers - all this shifted, mixed up, and confusion reigned on the screen. We had to change the logic of the interface, edit many elements, manually separate the numbers (after all, unlike the text, they are written from left to right). Overall, the amount of work turned out to be much more than we expected. But we hope that our efforts were not in vain, and this will allow native speakers of these two languages to play our game with more convenience than ever.

These are just some of the edits we have made to the game during this time. The full list will be published later, when the update is released to the public.

We will try to publish news more often, so stay with us, subscribe to our [url=http://discord.gg/invite/9eHyYap]Discord[/url] and [url=https://x.com/KishMishStudio]Twitter[/url] (yes, we still stubbornly call it that!). We have interesting ideas about what else can be implemented in the game, and we will tell you about it soon. Thank you for playing Fly Corp!

Fly Corp has become our most highly rated game yet, and we've been supporting it for several years. However, some players want something new, but with the same catchy and "addicting" game mechanics. So, we have been developing a new game in the economic strategy genre called Check Inn for quite some time. We are sure that [b]if you like Fly Corp, then you definitely need to take a look at Check Inn![/b]

This time, we will build hotels. We start with the cheapest, somewhere in the American wilderness. We build different rooms, trying to satisfy varied needs of guests (each guest wants a specific room!); we upgrade elevators so that visitors get to the necessary floors; We hire maids and managers to automate some of our tasks. The flow of guests is constantly increasing and we need to accommodate everyone on time.

[b]Demo version is already available![/b]

Try one of the first levels of the game yourself and feel free to share your feedback with us - as always, this is extremely important to us!

[b]Don't forget to add the game to your wishlist![/b] You can also watch the trailer on the game's page.

notes.title: Fly Corp on Mac and Dark Mode are available!
notes.content:
Today is an important day for Fly Corp! The game is finally available for Mac. Also, we're glad to show you the new update with Dark Mode and other game improvements.

We've got many requests to release the game on Mac. We faced some challenges while porting Fly Corp to Mac, but now they're solved for you to play on your favorite Apple computer.

Meanwhile, we released the update which adds Dark Mode to the game. The question of adding an alternative color palette for the map and interface became particularly acute after we made the colors in the game lighter last year. When playing indoors with dim lighting, at night, the dark theme looks especially nice and doesn't strain your eyes.

But this is not the only change. Here's more:
[list]
[*] The color palette in the game has been slightly modified. A darker shade of blue is now used for text, which improves readability. The color of water has also been slightly changed.
[*] The logic for displaying popular scenarios has been reworked. Now, only scenarios that were uploaded among the 60 most recent ones can be displayed in this section. notes.title: Fly Corp has been released from Early Access!
notes.content:
[h1]Today is the day when Fly Corp leaves the Early Access stage of development![/h1]

[h2]How the game has been developed[/h2]

Let’s take a look back in time and recall how we developed Fly Corp.

The idea of such game and very first versions appeared back in 2019, when we didn’t even know how many things we are going to add to the game. The whole initial idea was only about one game mode, but each month of development gave us a quite clear clue that we are actually working on a quite interesting and distinctive minimalist strategy. We had more and more ideas which were implemented sooner or later.

In 2021, the game finally saw Early Access release. The first public version already had both scenarios and Discover the World mode (by the way, the last one was unbeatable, and the whole competition was about the number of unlocked territories). We started to receive lots of useful feedback from you, and some of your ideas found their way into the game. We figured out that some players didn’t want to constantly compete with others. Rather, they just wanted to build their transport network. This is how Free Mode appeared, where you can’t lose because of an airport being overloaded.

Visuals have also seen many changes. Step by step, we made user interface more convenient, and game map - more appealing to look at. Random events got accompanied by corresponding pictures.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40269024/614c623d5f85ad0075dbc6b270b48a52aedde9cc.png[/img]
There were some large updates as well. Scenario editor was added, allowing players to create scenarios with their own conditions and specifications. Each day had a new scenario for players, where they can compete with others in the Leaderboard. Daily Scenarios breathed even more live into the game. We’d also like to thank our players who created and shared interesting scenarios - some of them made their way to Daily Mode.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40269024/1b27ca798246e987117d2dcfac4f08e363bc0da0.png[/img]
And now, when the game goes into the full-fledged release stage, we are happy to present to you the next stage of Fly Corp’s life.

[h2]The epic release update[/h2]

Now, each player can upload their scenario to the server, into the general scenario list. Everyone is free to open Custom Scenarios and dive into the stories created by other players.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40269024/ae546beb48d749ce0b872633da5bebb9700e88ac.png[/img]
Together with today’s update, we brought many other minor changes to the game.

We already have some important updates planned for the future. We’ll keep making the game better for you after the release.

[h2]***[/h2]

We’d like to say a huge “Thank You” to all players who’ve been following the project for all this time. We welcome new players and invite all of you to a fascinating world of passenger transportations and to cozy community in our social media!

notes.title: Update 03 Feb 2022 and plans for the future!
notes.content:
Hello, dear players!
In this post we'll tell you about what was fixed in today's patch and what's being worked on right now. From time to time, we see comments from people complaining that updates aren't released as frequently as they would like. We agree, but the game has been worked on every single day.

So, here's what we fixed in today's update:
- Fixed a bug which caused level 2 planes and airports to remain at level 2 after restart (if random event about upgraded planes or airport was triggered);
- Fixed bug with removing routes to or from blocked city;
- Fixed bug when money wasn't added to your balance after the event in which you get money and 3 cities are unlocked instantly;
- Fixed translations of reduced passenger flow event. Fixed logics of "Yes/No" choice in this event;
- Fixed font size of newly unlocked cities;
- Other minor fixes.

Why updates are worked on for more time than we planned? As we told before, Fly Corp is being developed since Summer of 2019. Initially, it was a strictly experimental product - we haven't developed anything like this before. But, the more work we put into this game, the more confidence we had that we were doing everything the right way. But, newer versions inherited the code of bad quality from earlier versions, and we had to maintain this code. Now we're working on re-writing it along with fixing bugs. As a part of this effort, random events system was made almost from scratch. We plan to support Fly Corp for a long time, and this is why it's very important to bring it into a good state under the hood so that it will become easier to develop the game.

Here are some recent news:

notes.title: A detailed look at Challenge Editor in Fly Corp
notes.content:
[h3]Hello everyone![/h3]

Today we’d like to tell you about an interesting feature which will become available for everyone in the end of this summer, and it’s called Challenge Editor.

We have information about several tens of thousands of cities around the world in our game, and we can use any of them while creating challenges. Each one is unique in a way that affects gameplay – distance to other cities and population (passenger flow depends on it). Some cities have their own random events: for example, a game exhibition can take place in Cologne and Los Angeles, and Octoberfest may begin in München. These events temporarily increase passenger flow to these cities.
Let us show how the editor works.

Let’s try to create a simple challenge about flights in USA to far cities. It would be quite expensive to build far routes – this is going to be the main challenge for player.
Interface of this editor is about to change as this is a very early look.

The first tab: we need to enter the name and description of our challenge. What is interesting – you can enter these on English and other languages supported by the game. The language selected in Settings will be chosen by default.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40269024/4a1905b2ba2fb22c7dda0a271282e13011c90588.jpg[/img]
 
The second screen is a lot more complex and contains many parameters which will determine, what will happen in the challenge. First of all, let’s add victory condition. Let it be: “Gather 30000 credits in 20 minutes”. On the same screen, let’s make Initial balance to 1000. It would be enough to connect the first few cities, upgrade a plane or launch a couple of new ones.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40269024/0d6e2e4a53b5cd848c167d46dac3721e769f5504.jpg[/img]
 
From time to time, random events can occur in the game, affecting the gameplay. Here you can choose how often they will occur or disable them fully. Also, here you can set the minimum population of an unlocked city. If population of the city is lower than this number, it won’t unlock in the challenge.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40269024/1e5a782dc1923d37686d4dbd076097b989a312bc.jpg[/img]
 
The percentage of domestic routes determines how many passengers will fly only inside the country. In our scenario, there is only one country – USA, so let’s not touch it now – it won’t affect anything. Let’s assign interval between unlocking cities (they will be chosen randomly), and how quick new passengers will appear in airports.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40269024/5a81151e1422b6bc3fd795b43f98d96f3e411ebb.jpg[/img]
 
The initial country is, of course, the USA. Let’s add the rule which won’t allow players to unlock other countries (other possible options: unlock any countries; unlock countries which have a common border with currently unlocked ones).
Let’s leave speed of the basic 1st level plane as is (but we can dramatically change game speed just my adjusting it).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40269024/912e73eab6316044521c79104e1da9e39c57e094.jpg[/img]
 
Here’s a game mechanic hidden from player: passenger flow generated by a city grows over time. After the determined time, passenger flow is increased twice. But the cities are unlocked gradually, so passenger flow grows very fluently in the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40269024/abad016373ffb85ecf81ec79f951216f87a001d5.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40269024/870e04349986e955cd063acb83ef01b9ac989c19.jpg[/img]
  
Now let’s pay our attention to the third tab. It’s Timeline, and it determines what will happen in the game during the challenge. Let’s click on it and add two cities to be unlocked at the start – we’ll connect them to the capital.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40269024/12ca947a5f2bd8ffbdfa11d4c0d78caa1c3766f3.jpg[/img]
 
Let’s create one more event: unlock Seattle City on the seventh minute of gameplay. Pay attention to the number in brackets – it’s population of this city, and as you remember, it influences the passenger flow into and from it.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40269024/2199a279513c691207cd9a03efe8b1c65d4d8408.jpg[/img]
 
Now let’s add a couple of cities distant from the central part of the country:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40269024/bc02c65528b71b4f9f958ba3d1310c2414de5caf.jpg[/img]
 
Let’s make our own event! According to our evil plan, player would have to pay taxes on the eighth minute. To do that, we add events “Subtract money” and “Show message” (so that the player knows the reason why his balance decreased).
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40269024/8819af358fc2af5a88eb034395c3cdb362e40643.jpg[/img] 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40269024/40b1cde0b1e9bc71171b27e5fea0806bd0298853.jpg[/img]

You can also add pre-set events like volcano eruption, pandemics, global crisis and others. All of them will affect gameplay in this or that way.
Finally, let’s give name to the challenge file and test it.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40269024/e978ed29d070e2442fc92101374530f01c007146.jpg[/img]
 
By default, we only have capital and two cities we chose on the timeline. After 1,5 minutes, just like we entered, a random city was unlocked – New York, After 1,5 more minutes – Chicago. Now we can connect them and begin building our network.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40269024/444b158a648b8b1a47a6879e4d88d05fb6500e4c.jpg[/img]
 
The cities are unlocked constantly. Here’s the Seattle! Let’s build a route by connecting it with Albuquerque.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40269024/ebd0ba2c32ea7cd04bcf256a78c82bc539e4a435.jpg[/img]
 
The time passes, new routes are being built, new planes are bought. Despite these costs, we still earn money. We need to save as much as we can to connect Alaska and Hawaii to our network, just like we stated on the Timeline.
We believe that challenge editor will drastically change the game and make it more replayable. After that, we’d like to implement the database of user-created challenges with search, ratings etc.
As for right now – the game has quite many pre-created challenges – all of them are created in this editor and you can try them right now.
Thank you for attention, have a nice flight!

Despite the quite minimalistic look of the game, we've been doing our best to make the gameplay deep and involving while keeping the controls simple and easy to use.

[h3]So, what this game is?[/h3]
You're about to develop your own airline transport network in various cities and countries by creating routes, buying new planes, upgrading airports and airplanes. The game features an advanced passenger flow system. All cities are real, and their population corresponds with reality. The more the population is, the higher is the number of people who want to fly somewhere. Every passenger has their destination point and, if no direct route is available, he would fly with changes.
